Ingredients
------------

2 tbsp unsalted butter

1 large onion, chopped
1 1/2 cups dry breadcrumbs
1 1/2 cups shredded Cheddar cheese
1/4 cup chopped fresh parsley
2 garlic cloves, grated
1 (22 oz) can crushed tomatoes
1 tsp dried oregano
Salt and pepper, to taste

Instructions
-----------
Heat the oven to 350º. Grease a baking pan. In a small bowl, mix together the chopped parsley, grated garlic, and crushed tomatoes.

Reduce the heat and add the breadcrumbs, Cheddar cheese, salt, and pepper. Mix well and cook, stirring occasionally, until the breadcrumbs are lightly browned, about 5 minutes. Remove from the heat, and stir in the oregano.
To assemble, place a scoop of the mixture into the center of each of two 9 x 13-inch baking pans, creating a 1-inch border around each of the mounds of filling. Spread a thin layer of tomato mixture evenly over the cheese and sprinkle with parsley.
